mistake_reason: The Geospatial_Expert relied on a clearly truncated and incomplete "List of landlocked countries" excerpt that did not include Bhutan, and proceeded without asking for clarification or requesting the full list. This led to the unfounded assumption that Bhutan has coastal access, inflating the count to 13. The agent failed to seek additional information when faced with ambiguous/incomplete data, directly matching FM-2.2 (Fail to Ask for Clarification).
